page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9i.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The hardware profile provides 4 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 16.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This server instance contains no bundled local storage, meaning that all persistent disk storage must be provisioned via attached network volumes. It features a baseline network throughput of 4 Gbps and includes no complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Hardware accelerators are absent, with zero GPUs included in the configuration.

From a cost-efficiency and resource-allocation perspective, the balanced ratio between compute capacity and system RAM avoids paying for underutilized memory arrays. The instance is suited for enterprise application workloads including backend web serving, containerized microservices, build nodes in CI/CD pipelines, and moderate database deployments.
